adjudicated_findings.title: Resource Defer Statement Inside Loop Body
adjudicated_findings.adjudication_rationale: Code inspection confirms defer f.Close() is called inside a for loop body. File descriptors accumulate unclosed until InspectFiles returns, causing resource exhaustion on directories with many files.

adjudicated_findings.title: Ignored function error return value
adjudicated_findings.adjudication_rationale: Code inspection confirms _ = c.handler(ctx, msg) discards the error returned by the message handler without error logging, metric increment, or dead-letter queuing.

adjudicated_findings.title: No continuous integration (CI) workflows detected
adjudicated_findings.adjudication_rationale: Repository lacks CI workflow configuration. Legitimate maintainability and hygiene concern, but not a functional runtime defect.

adjudicated_findings.title: Missing README documentation
adjudicated_findings.adjudication_rationale: Absence of top-level documentation. Maintainability concern.

adjudicated_findings.title: Missing repository LICENSE file
adjudicated_findings.adjudication_rationale: Absence of root LICENSE file. Legal/hygiene concern.

adjudicated_findings.title: Missing go.sum lockfile
adjudicated_findings.adjudication_rationale: Repository defines go.mod with zero external dependencies, so go.sum was not generated by go mod download. Valid supply chain integrity concern.

adjudicated_findings.title: Exported Symbols Lack Automated Unit Tests
adjudicated_findings.adjudication_rationale: Heuristic AST analysis detects exported functions without direct corresponding test functions in *_test.go. Legitimate engineering hygiene observation, but not a defect.
